lines.en: label mayadorm15:
I knock on Maya's door and wait for her to answer, figuring that the chance of her doing so is somewhere around 25%%.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Maya 的门等她回应，估计她回应的概率大概在 25% 左右。

lines.en: That number greatly increases when I hear footsteps approaching just seconds later.
lines.zh: 几秒后就听到脚步声走近，这个数字大幅上升。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux1
: What do you want?
lines.zh: : 你想干什么？

lines.en: : Just to say hi.
lines.zh: : 就来打个招呼。

lines.en: : Hello.
lines.zh: : 你好。

lines.en: : Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 再见。

lines.en: : Wait. There's more.
lines.zh: : 等等。还有呢。

lines.en: : Is there? Or are you just pretending there is more because you don't want me to leave right away?
lines.zh: : 有吗？还是说你只是在假装「还有」，因为你不想让我马上走？

lines.en: : I guess it would be closer to the latter. But that doesn't mean there can't...{i}be{/i} more?
lines.zh: : 我想更接近后者。但「{i}还有{/i}」也不是……不可能？

lines.en: : Can I help you with something? Or is listening to you mindlessly flounder just what I'll have to do for the rest of the night?
lines.zh: : 我能帮你什么吗？还是说我今晚剩下的时间就得听你无脑地挣扎？

lines.en: : I don't think I need any help, no. But what about you?
lines.zh: : 我想我不需要帮忙，不需要。不过你呢？

lines.en: : Need me to, like...carry any boxes or something?
lines.zh: : 需要我……搬个箱子什么的吗？

lines.en: : Is that something you would do right now if I asked you to?
lines.zh: : 如果我现在开口，你真会去干吗？

lines.en: : I'd rather not, to be honest. I just don't know what else you normally do at night.
lines.zh: : 说实话我不太想。我只是不知道你晚上一般都干什么。

lines.en: : I see. So you’re here to harass me and not assist me.
lines.zh: : 明白了。所以你是来骚扰我的，不是来帮忙的。

lines.en: : Well, I wouldn’t say {i}harass{/i}...
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不会用「{i}骚扰{/i}」这个词……

lines.en: : Then what would you say? Annoy?
lines.zh: : 那你会用什么？烦我？

lines.en: : You know, I’m starting to get the feeling you don’t really like me all that much.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我开始觉得你不是那么喜欢我了。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux2
: What would have possibly given you that idea?
lines.zh: : 是什么让你产生了这种想法？

lines.en: : A hunch, I guess. Combined with the fact that every time the two of us talk, you look like you're about to either vomit or fall asleep. Or both.
lines.zh: : 直觉吧，我猜。再加上每次我俩说话，你看起来都要么快吐了、要么快睡着了。或者两个一起来。

lines.en: : You're disgusting.
lines.zh: : 你真恶心。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux3
: But...perhaps there is something you could do for me after all.
lines.zh: : 不过……也许还真有一件事你能为我做。

lines.en: : Does it involve a box?
lines.zh: : 跟箱子有关吗？

lines.en: : No. But it involves following me roughly two miles west.
lines.zh: : 不。但它要你跟着我往西走大约两英里。

lines.en: : That’s...a strange proposition.
lines.zh: : 那……是个奇怪的提议。

lines.en: : Is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And, if I didn't know any better, I'd say it might even sound like a date.
lines.zh: : 是。而且，要不是我有数，我会说那听起来甚至像一场约会。

lines.en: : If your idea of a {i}date{/i} is following someone for two miles in the dark, I hope that you never find love for the rest of your life.
lines.zh: : 如果你心目中的{i}约会{/i}是摸黑跟人走两英里，那我希望你这辈子都找不到爱情。

lines.en: : I won't, for my heart already belongs to you.
lines.zh: : 不会的，因为我的心已经属于你了。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux4
: Ha ha ha. Hilarious.
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈。真好笑。

lines.en: : I take it you'll have no qualms with buying me dinner, then? Since your {i}heart belongs to me{/i} and all.
lines.zh: : 那你给我买晚饭应该毫无芥蒂吧？毕竟{i}你的心属于我{/i}什么的。

lines.en: : Huh? I mean...I guess I can get you dinner. But why do we need to walk two miles away for it? There are plenty of closer places.
lines.zh: : 哈？我是说……我想我可以请你吃晚饭。可我们为什么非得走两英里？近的地方多的是。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux1
: Is that a no? Because I am very hungry and don't have much money to spend right now.
lines.zh: : 那是拒绝吗？因为我很饿，而且现在没什么钱。

lines.en: : If I say no, what's the alternative? Panhandling?
lines.zh: : 如果我拒绝，你打算怎么办？讨饭？

lines.en: : I’m an incredibly attractive teenage girl. I'm sure there is {i}something{/i} I could be doing at this time of night to come up with the money.
lines.zh: : 我是个极其迷人的青春期女孩。这个点儿我肯定有{i}别的办法{/i}弄到钱。

lines.en: : I...don't like the sound of that. So, sure. I'll buy your dinner tonight under the pretense that you never say anything like that again.
lines.zh: : 我……不喜欢那种说法。所以，行。今晚我请你吃晚饭，前提是你再也别说那种话。

lines.en: : Look at you, masking your jealousy as genuine worry. How adorable.
lines.zh: : 看看你，把嫉妒伪装成真切的担忧。多可爱。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux0
Maya breaks eye contact with me and begins to head for the exit. The scent of watermelon shampoo drifts past me along with her body.
lines.zh: Maya 移开与我的对视，朝出口走去。一股西瓜洗发水的气味随着她的身体从我身边掠过。

lines.en: : Come. I would like to get there as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 来。我想尽快到那儿。

lines.en: scene black
I chase after the scent.
lines.zh: 我追着那股气味。

lines.en: Down the stairs.
lines.zh: 下了楼梯。

lines.en: Out of the dorm.
lines.zh: 出了宿舍。

lines.en: Into the street.
lines.zh: 走上街头。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux5
: So...where are we going exactly?
lines.zh: : 那么……我们到底要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Does it matter?
lines.zh: : 重要吗？

lines.en: : Kind of, yeah. I don’t want you dragging me to some weird cult meeting or something.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。我可不想被你拖去参加什么奇怪的邪教集会。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Then you should probably head back.
lines.zh: : 那你大概该回去了。

lines.en: : I’m taking you to meet god.
lines.zh: : 我要带你去见神。

lines.en: : That was a joke. Ha ha.
lines.zh: : 那是个玩笑。哈哈。

lines.en: : You may laugh now.
lines.zh: : 你现在可以笑了。

lines.en: : You’re so fucking weird.
lines.zh: : 你他妈真怪。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux6
: You have no right to say that when you spend every waking moment stalking girls roughly ninety years younger than you.
lines.zh: : 你每个醒着的时刻都在跟踪比你小大概九十岁的女孩，没资格说这话。

lines.en: : I feel like your estimation of my age goes up several years every time we talk.
lines.zh: : 我感觉你对我年龄的估计，每次我们聊天都要涨几岁。

lines.en: : Poor you...
lines.zh: : 可怜的你……

lines.en: : Just tell me where we’re going and I’ll be quiet the rest of the way. I promise.
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我我们去哪儿，我保证剩下的路都不出声。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux5
: As if I would believe that.
lines.zh: : 好像我会信似的。

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux7
: Takoyaki...
lines.zh: : 章鱼烧……

lines.en: : We’re walking two miles away for fried octopus balls?
lines.zh: : 我们走两英里就为了吃炸章鱼丸子？

lines.en: : I’m fine with going alone if you just give me the money.
lines.zh: : 如果你把钱给我，我一个人去也行。

lines.en: : You know, you're lucky I'm such a generous guy or-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，也就我这么大方的家伙——

lines.en: : What happened to remaining silent after hearing the answer?
lines.zh: : 你之前说的「听到答案就保持安静」呢？

lines.en: : I didn't expect the answer to be something so...odd.
lines.zh: : 我没想到答案会这么……怪。

lines.en: : What's so odd about takoyaki? It's an extremely common street food.
lines.zh: : 章鱼烧有什么怪的？那是极其常见的街头小吃。

lines.en: : Yes. So common that we can find it significantly closer than two miles away.
lines.zh: : 是。常见到我们根本不用走两英里就能找到。

lines.en: : And yet you're still following me instead of just handing over the money.
lines.zh: : 而你还是在跟着我走，而不是把钱直接给我。

lines.en: : It's not too late to back down, you know.
lines.zh: : 现在反悔还来得及，你知道的。

lines.en: : It's not like either one of us is going to have a good time.
lines.zh: : 反正我俩谁都不会玩得开心。

lines.en: : Nah. I'm in it for the long haul at this point.
lines.zh: : 不。到这地步我已经打算扛到底了。

lines.en: : I see...
lines.zh: : 这样啊……

lines.en: scene takoyakiredux5
: Then I suggest you remain quiet until we get there.
lines.zh: : 那我建议你在到那儿之前保持安静。

lines.en: : I did as you asked, so now you must do as you were.
lines.zh: : 我照你说的做了，所以现在轮到你说话算话了。

lines.en: : Fine. Whatever. But don't come crying if you get bored along the way.
lines.zh: : 行。随便。不过路上觉得无聊可别哭着来找我。

lines.en: scene black
I decide it's easier to remain silent than give up my money and wind up silently following Maya to wherever her...takoyaki-related destination is.
lines.zh: 我决定沉默比交出我的钱更容易，于是就这么不吭声地跟着 Maya 走向她那个……跟章鱼烧有关的目的地。

lines.en: We walk closer together than we did when I carried her boxes.
lines.zh: 我们走得比上次扛她箱子时近了一些。

lines.en: The scent of shampoo returns each time a breeze kicks up and I conjure up the image of her with her hair pinned back in the bath to battle the awkward silence this night has thrown at me.
lines.zh: 每有一阵风刮起，那股洗发水的味道就回来一次，而我用「她在澡堂里把头发挽起来」的画面，来对抗这晚扔给我的尴尬沉默。

lines.en: It’s colder than usual. Almost like it's not even summer anymore.
lines.zh: 比平时冷。几乎像是夏天已经过去了。

lines.en: Part of me wonders if she would want to wear my jacket.
lines.zh: 我有点想她会不会愿意披上我的外套。

lines.en: But then the other part of me realizes that she’d likely insult me for even offering her anything that has touched my skin.
lines.zh: 可另一部分的我意识到，光是给她任何碰过我皮肤的东西，她大概都会反过来骂我。

lines.en: And so we remain several feet apart.
lines.zh: 于是我们依然隔着几英尺。

lines.en: And she remains cold.
lines.zh: 而她依然冷着。

lines.en: scene takoyaki1
We show up at a two-window food stall situated in the middle of nowhere.
lines.zh: 我们来到一个开在荒郊野外的双窗口小吃摊前。

lines.en: Well, I say the middle of nowhere, but it’s more like a suburban area I’ve never seen before.
lines.zh: 嗯，说是荒郊野外，其实更像我从没见过的一片郊区。

lines.en: How does Maya even know about a place like this?
lines.zh: Maya 怎么会知道这种地方？

lines.en: And what’s the point in coming all the way out here just for takoyaki when there were countless other places she could have gone?
lines.zh: 而且，明明有无数别的地方可去，专程跑到这儿来吃章鱼烧有什么意义？

lines.en: Common sense dictates that the reason would be one of two things-
lines.zh: 常识告诉我，原因只可能是两种之一——

lines.en: Either she prefers the taste of this specific takoyaki cart's food-
lines.zh: 要么她偏喜欢这个特定章鱼烧摊的味道——

lines.en: Or it holds some sort of significance for her.
lines.zh: 要么这儿对她有某种意义。

lines.en: scene takoyaki2
The two of us walk up to the stall and I position myself away from the window to show I’m not interested in personally buying anything.
lines.zh: 我俩走到摊前，我站得离窗口远一些，表示我自己不打算买。

lines.en: I’m simply here to pay for the dinner of my [niece]’s best friend- a totally normal scenario that I'm sure every uncle has to deal with several times a year.
lines.zh: 我只是来为我[niece]最好的朋友付晚饭钱的——一个完全正常的场景，我确信每个叔叔一年都得应付好几次。

lines.en: Maya peers through the window and speaks to someone it appears she knows.
lines.zh: Maya 往窗口里探，跟一个看起来是她认识的人说话。

lines.en: scene takoyaki3
: The usual, please.
lines.zh: : 老样子，谢谢。

lines.en: An old man behind the counter nods, grunting to acknowledge her order.
lines.zh: 柜台后面的老头点点头，咕哝一声表示接单。

lines.en: He's one of very few men that I have actually seen around here, so I imagine he wasn't drafted due to either his age or...some sort of condition I'm not aware of.
lines.zh: 他是我在这儿实际见过的极少数几个男人之一，所以我猜他没被征兵，要么是因为年纪，要么是……某种我不知道的状况。

lines.en: He likely doesn’t have much time left anyway.
lines.zh: 他大概也没剩多少时间了。

lines.en: Better to die serving octopus than to die in space, I guess.
lines.zh: 我想，与其死在太空里，不如死在伺候章鱼烧上。

lines.en: scene takoyaki4
: Do you want anything?
lines.zh: : 你要点什么吗？

lines.en: : Wow, kind enough to let me buy things with my own money?
lines.zh: : 哇，这么大方，让我用自己的钱买东西？

lines.en: : Is that a yes or a no? I need to know before he’s finished or he’ll get angry.
lines.zh: : 那是要还是不要？他做完之前我得知道，不然他会生气的。

lines.en: The old man lifts his head and his eyes meet mine.
lines.zh: 老头抬起头，目光与我相遇。

lines.en: I can already see a scowl beginning to form on his face, but he says nothing.
lines.zh: 我已经能看出他脸上开始酝酿出怒意，但他什么都没说。

lines.en: He just...stares at me.
lines.zh: 他就只是……盯着我。

lines.en: : I’m fine. I’ll just pay for whatever you’re having.
lines.zh: : 我不用。我付你要的那份就行。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Maybe another time, then.
lines.zh: : 那下次吧。

lines.en: scene black
The man finishes Maya’s order and presents her with several trays of takoyaki.
lines.zh: 那人做完 Maya 的点单，递给她好几盘章鱼烧。

lines.en: I need to help carry them as her arms are too small to do it on her own.
lines.zh: 我得帮她拿，因为她的胳膊太小了，一个人拿不动。

lines.en: The scent of watermelon shampoo is unfortunately consumed by one significantly more pungent.
lines.zh: 不幸的是，西瓜洗发水的气味被一股浓烈得多的气味盖过去了。

lines.en: scene takoyaki5
: Aren’t you going to eat?
lines.zh: : 你不吃吗？

lines.en: : It makes me uncomfortable with you just watching me like that.
lines.zh: : 你就那么看着我，我很不自在。

lines.en: : Is it because you eat at the speed of light and are afraid of somehow ruining your image in front of me?
lines.zh: : 是因为你吃东西的速度像光速，怕在我面前毁了形象？

lines.en: : I doubt there is {i}anything{/i} I could do to make you less attracted to me, but I would be a liar if I said I was not a little self-conscious.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑我做{i}什么{/i}都不可能让你对我少一点兴趣，不过要是我说我一点都不在意形象，那是在撒谎。

lines.en: : Are you? If I could eat the way you do, I'd be showing everyone.
lines.zh: : 是吗？要是我能像你那样吃，我会表演给所有人看的。

lines.en: : Wow. It’s almost as if we’re completely different people or something. Whoever could have predicted this?
lines.zh: : 哇。简直就像我们是完全不同的两个人什么的。谁能预料到呢？

lines.en: : I don’t appreciate the sarcasm, Maya. Especially right after I just bought you dinner.
lines.zh: : 我不吃这套，Maya。尤其是我刚给你买完晚饭。

lines.en: scene takoyaki6
: Oh, you’re right. Thank you for buying all of this for me.
lines.zh: : 哦，你说得对。谢谢你给我买这些。

lines.en: : Wait, are you actually thanking me? Because I was just messing around about the whole eating in front of me thing.
lines.zh: : 等等，你是真的在谢我？因为当着我的面吃那事我只是随口说说。

lines.en: : I really don't care what you do or don't do with the food I bought you. It's yours to...eat or...throw or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我真的不在乎你拿我给你买的食物干什么。它是你的，可以……吃、扔、随便。

lines.en: : Do I look like the type of person to start throwing octopus balls around?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像那种会把章鱼丸子到处扔的人吗？

lines.en: : Maybe?
lines.zh: : 也许？

lines.en: : I am greatly offended by this.
lines.zh: : 我深受冒犯。

lines.en: : Thank you, though. Even if you are the worst person I have ever met, I'm grateful that you bought dinner for me.
lines.zh: : 不过还是谢谢你。就算你是我见过最糟糕的人，我还是感激你给我买了晚饭。

lines.en: : It's whatever. I’ve got some money to spare.
lines.zh: : 无所谓。我手头宽裕。

lines.en: : It’s not like I’m constantly paying for takeout or anything since Ami is always cooking at home, so...it's really no big deal.
lines.zh: : 反正 Ami 总在家做饭，我也不用老是买外卖什么的，所以……真的没什么大不了。

lines.en: scene takoyaki7
: I see.
lines.zh: : 明白了。

lines.en: : Then...perhaps we might return here sometime.
lines.zh: : 那么……也许我们哪天可以再来。

lines.en: : Are you...actually saying we should do this again? Because that really {i}does{/i} make it sound like a date this time.
lines.zh: : 你是……真的在提议我们再来一次？因为那听起来{i}真的{/i}像约会了。

lines.en: scene takoyaki6
: I’m merely accepting my fate.
lines.zh: : 我只是在接受我的命运。

lines.en: : This again?
lines.zh: : 又是这个？

lines.en: : Again?
lines.zh: : 又是？

lines.en: : Well...didn’t we just have a discussion about fate the other day at the shrine?
lines.zh: : 嗯……我们不是前几天在神社刚讨论过命运吗？

lines.en: : Ah, yes. When you decided to act out of character. I remember now.
lines.zh: : 啊，对。就是你决定表现得不像自己那次。我想起来了。

lines.en: : So...do you want to continue that discussion? Or...
lines.zh: : 所以……你想接着那场讨论吗？还是……

lines.en: : No thank you.
lines.zh: : 不了，谢谢。

lines.en: : There is something else I would like to discuss, though.
lines.zh: : 不过有另一件事我想跟你谈。

lines.en: : Well, that's new. It's not like you to actually {i}want{/i} to talk about something with me.
lines.zh: : 这可新鲜了。你不像是会{i}想{/i}跟我谈什么事的人。

lines.en: : It's less that I {i}want{/i} to and...more that I feel I {i}should.{/i}
lines.zh: : 与其说是我{i}想{/i}谈……不如说是我觉得我{i}该{/i}谈。

lines.en: : Besides, do you really think I would have come all the way here with you if I did not have something to discuss?
lines.zh: : 再说，你真以为如果我没有要谈的事，我会跟你走到这么远？

lines.en: : That’s slightly offensive, but you've got a point.
lines.zh: : 这话有点伤人，不过你有道理。

lines.en: : I’ll hear you out. Just try not getting {i}too{/i} weird this time.
lines.zh: : 我洗耳恭听。只是这次尽量别{i}太{/i}怪。

lines.en: : I will do my best, but I surely expect you to think I've failed immediately.
lines.zh: : 我会尽力的，不过我肯定你马上就会觉得我已经失败了。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？

lines.en: scene takoyaki8
Maya stabs a toothpick into a piece of takoyaki and twirls it around to cool it off, causing some of the fish flakes to fly off and get carried away by the wind.
lines.zh: Maya 拿一根牙签扎起一颗章鱼烧，转着圈给它散热，几片鲣鱼屑被吹飞，随风飘走了。

lines.en: : You’re...
lines.zh: : 你在……

lines.en: : You're changing too quickly.
lines.zh: : 你变太快了。

lines.en: : Yeah, you've failed immediately. That's already a little too weird for me, but I'll continue to humor you.
lines.zh: : 是，你立刻就失败了。那对我来说已经有点太怪了，不过我会继续配合你。

lines.en: : Changing how? What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 变快？什么意思？

lines.en: : You’re doing things you’re not supposed to.
lines.zh: : 你在做你不该做的事。

lines.en: : Is this just another strange way of telling me to leave you alone? Because-
lines.zh: : 这又是什么叫我别来烦你的怪说法吗？因为——

lines.en: : No.
: This is something much more serious than that.
lines.zh: : 这比那严重得多。

lines.en: scene takoyaki9
: Something...is going to happen very soon.
lines.zh: : 有一件事……很快就要发生了。

lines.en: : Something that may...confuse you.
lines.zh: : 一件可能会……让你困惑的事。

lines.en: : Is it our next meeting? Because if so, I think you might be onto something.
lines.zh: : 是我们的下一次见面吗？如果是的话，我想你大概说到点子上了。

lines.en: scene takoyaki10
: I know it's hard for you, but please try to be serious for a moment.
lines.zh: : 我知道这对你来说很难，但请你认真一会儿。

lines.en: : Okay...Sure.
I can feel my shoulders tense up a bit, but I'm not sure if it's due to her expression or the uncertainty of whatever she's about to tell me.
lines.zh: 我能感觉到肩膀绷紧了，但我不确定是因为她的表情，还是因为她即将告诉我的事的未知性。

lines.en: Either way, she's being more serious than normal and...it wouldn't be fair to just ignore that.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，她比平时都要严肃……而无视这一点不公平。

lines.en: scene takoyaki11
: Something is...very different about you.
lines.zh: : 你身上有什么……非常不一样。

lines.en: : And I’m not just talking about your rebirth. That’s old news as far as I'm concerned.
lines.zh: : 而我说的不只是你的重生。对我来说那已经是旧闻了。

lines.en: : We’ve already discussed how everything in the world is part of a cycle...
lines.zh: : 我们已经讨论过，世上的一切都是一个循环的一部分……

lines.en: : And how everything will end in the same place regardless of what you or I may want at that moment in time.
lines.zh: : 也讨论过，不管你我在某个时刻想要什么，一切都会在同一个地方终结。

lines.en: : But what do you think would happen if those cycles were to converge?
lines.zh: : 可如果这些循环汇聚到一起，你觉得会发生什么？

lines.en: : What? What do you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 什么？你那是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean...Would you be able to handle the memories of hundreds of thousands of lifetimes if they were to all rush in at once?
lines.zh: : 我是说……如果成百上千世的记忆一下子全涌进来，你承受得住吗？

lines.en: scene takoyaki12

lines.zh: : 或者……

lines.en: : Would something like that break you?...
lines.zh: : 那样的事会不会把你压垮？……

lines.en: Maya looks away in an expression even more unfamiliar than the one she gave me just moments ago.
lines.zh: Maya 移开了视线，露出一个比刚才更陌生的表情。

lines.en: This no longer sounds like just another one of her philosophical ramblings.
lines.zh: 这听起来不再只是她又一次哲学式的喃喃自语。

lines.en: This sounds like a warning.
lines.zh: 这听起来像一个警告。

lines.en: : Beats me, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。

lines.en: scene takoyaki13
: Huh?
: {i}Beats me?{/i} That's your response?
lines.zh: : 「{i}我哪知道{/i}」？这就是你的回答？

lines.en: : Was that...the wrong answer?
lines.zh: : 那……是错的答案吗？

lines.en: : There is no {i}wrong{/i} answer. I just expected you to call me crazy or come up with some stupid joke, not shrug it off like it's some type of pointless {i}what-if.{/i}
lines.zh: : 没有{i}错误{/i}的答案。我只是以为你会骂我疯了、或者编个烂笑话，而不是把它当成某种无聊的{i}假设{/i}来耸耸肩。

lines.en: : I'm asking you this for a reason. Not just because I'm curious about your point of view.
lines.zh: : 我问你这个是有原因的。不只是因为好奇你的看法。

lines.en: : This really is serious. And it deserves a serious-
lines.zh: : 这事真的很严重。值得一个严肃的——

lines.en: : I am serious, though. Which is exactly why I'm not...making jokes or mocking you right now.
lines.zh: : 可我很认真啊。这正是我现在没有……开玩笑或嘲笑你的原因。

lines.en: : What's a more reasonable response to someone being bombarded by the...memories of hundreds of thousands of lifetimes rushing in at once or...whatever it was you said?
lines.zh: : 「成百上千世的记忆同时涌进来」这种事……或者不管你说的那个是什么，还能有什么更合理的回应？

lines.en: : That's not something a normal person would have an answer to off hand.
lines.zh: : 正常人是没法当场回答那种问题的。

lines.en: : If that happens, I'll just...deal with it, I guess.
lines.zh: : 如果真发生了，我就……应付它吧，我想。

lines.en: : But...to more directly answer the second part of your question-
lines.zh: : 不过……更直接地回答你第二个问题——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不会。

lines.en: : I don't think something like that would break me.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得那种事会把我压垮。

lines.en: : I can't bring myself to believe that.
lines.zh: : 我没法让自己相信这个。

lines.en: : You don't know what it would be like. You have no idea what sort of effect that could have on a person.
lines.zh: : 你不知道那会是什么样。你根本不知道那会对一个人造成什么影响。

lines.en: : Hey. You asked and I answered. I didn't think we were going to be having a whole debate about this.
lines.zh: : 嘿。你问了，我答了。我可没想过我们要为这个展开一场辩论。

lines.en: scene takoyaki14
: You...really are strange...
lines.zh: : 你……真的很奇怪……

lines.en: : You’re one to talk.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。

lines.en: scene takoyaki15
: Hah...
: I guess that answer wasn’t {i}horrible{/i}, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我想那个回答不算{i}太糟{/i}……

lines.en: : We’ll just have to see how things play out from here.
lines.zh: : 接下来会怎样，我们只能走着瞧了。

lines.en: : But...for your sake...I really hope you're right.
lines.zh: : 可是……为了你自己……我真希望你是对的。

lines.en: : You're actually caring about {i}my{/i} sake for once? I figured you'd be wishing for the exact opposite.
lines.zh: : 你居然为{i}我的{/i}事操心了？我还以为你会希望完全相反。

lines.en: : Yes, well...that's because you don't understand me at all.
lines.zh: : 是，嗯……那是因为你根本不了解我。

lines.en: : You...definitely don't make it easy for me, at the very least.
lines.zh: : 你……确实不让我好了解你，至少这一点没错。

lines.en: scene takoyaki16
: No...I suppose I don't.
lines.zh: : 不……我想是的。

lines.en: scene black
The discussion quickly moves away from more serious topics after that.
lines.zh: 之后，讨论很快就离开了更严肃的话题。

lines.en: Maya winds up biting the bullet and eating her takoyaki in front of me while I continue to look on as if her consumption of octopus is some new form of spectator sport.
lines.zh: Maya 最后豁出去了，当着我的面吃起了章鱼烧，而我继续旁观，好像她吃章鱼是什么新型的观赏运动。

lines.en: She paces herself, though...proving once and for all that she really is still a [teenage]girl at the end of the day.
lines.zh: 不过她吃得很节制……再次证明了，说到底，她确实还是个[teenage]女孩。

lines.en: The two of us walk back to the dorm in silence after she finally finishes her dinner.
lines.zh: 等她终于吃完晚饭，我俩沉默地走回宿舍。

lines.en: And while I say {i}silence{/i}, the true soundtrack of the trip home is the endless screaming of cicadas and the soft clopping of Maya's boots against the ground.
lines.zh: 而我说的「{i}沉默{/i}」，真正的回家配乐是蝉无休止的鸣叫，和 Maya 的靴子落在地上的轻响。

lines.en: I can still smell the takoyaki.
lines.zh: 我还能闻到章鱼烧的味道。

$ maya_love += 1
{i}Maya’s affection has increased to [maya_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Maya 的好感度提升到了 [maya_love]！{/i}
